entities.summary: Democracy Movement of 1990, a transformative movement in Bangladesh (1990–1991). Emerged from Muhammad Yunus founds Grameen Bank, pioneering microfinance and Ziaur Rahman. Catalyzed Sheikh Hasina's Awami League.
